title: A push that changes only the ledger runs ci
foundBy: user report (host): "support ledger builds on pushes that only contain ledger changes, with just linting, ledger checking, and a pages build to publish the ledger page"
details: Closing an issue is a commit that changes only `ledger/`, and pushing it runs the whole of `ci`. Nothing `ci` checks has changed but the records, and each run adds to the history the status file reads. Such a push needs only the ledger check, the document linters and a site build, which publishes the ledger's page.
